import subprocess
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
import typer

def test_launch_wait_false():
    # Mock Popen and its wait method
    mock_popen = MagicMock()
    mock_process = MagicMock()
    mock_process.wait.return_value = 0
    mock_popen.return_value = mock_process

    # We need to make sure _is_linux_or_bsd returns True and shutil.which("xdg-open") returns something
    with patch("typer.main._is_linux_or_bsd", return_value=True), \
         patch("shutil.which", return_value="/usr/bin/xdg-open"), \
         patch("subprocess.Popen", mock_popen):
        
        # Case 1: wait=False
        result = typer.launch("https://example.com", wait=False)
        assert result == 0
        # wait() should NOT have been called
        assert mock_process.wait.call_count == 0

        # Reset mock
        mock_process.wait.call_count = 0

        # Case 2: wait=True
        result = typer.launch("https://example.com", wait=True)
        assert result == 0
        # wait() SHOULD have been called
        assert mock_process.wait.call_count == 1

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        test_launch_wait_false()
        print("Test passed!")
    except AssertionError as e:
        print(f"Test failed: {e}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"An error occurred: {e}")
